rationale: Canada military base fire kills four (ally tragedy); US grants deportation reprieve to Ukrainian and Sudanese migrants (domestic policy shift); Rubio denies withholding Ukraine intelligence (foreign policy rhetoric).

top_events.title: Four people killed in 'violent, fast-moving' fire at Canadian military base
top_events.label: Four killed violent fire Canadian military base
top_events.summary: Prime Minister Carney describes blaze as one of worst peacetime tragedies for forces on Canadian soil. Dozens seriously injured at CFB Wainwright, Alberta.

top_events.title: US grants deportation reprieve to migrants from Ukraine and Sudan
top_events.label: US grants deportation reprieve Ukraine Sudan migrants
top_events.summary: DHS says migrants retain protections after temporary protected status was set to expire Monday. Policy shift affects over 100,000 people from Ukraine and Sudan.

top_events.title: Zelensky and US envoys holding Oslo talks as Rubio denies withholding intelligence
top_events.label: Rubio denies withholding Ukraine intelligence Oslo talks
top_events.summary: US Secretary of State rejects accusations that withheld intelligence is causing Ukrainian casualties. Talks continue in Oslo amid ongoing tensions.

short_summary: Obama blasts federal probe of Ilhan Omar

most_significant_event.label: Obama blasts federal probe of Ilhan Omar
most_significant_event.summary: Obama says federal agents' search of Democrat's home was effort to intimidate Trump critic. Domestic political controversy over law enforcement targeting of opposition figure.
most_significant_event.title: Obama blasts federal probe of congresswoman Ilhan Omar as 'so appalling'
